company.description:
99designs is the global creative platform that makes it easy for designers and clients to work together create designs they love. Their tried-and-true creative process has become the go-to solution for businesses, agencies and individuals.

Since 2008, 99designs has grown from a small, online forum into a global community of talented designers. Headquartered in Melbourne, Australia with offices in Oakland, California and Berlin, Germany, 99designs champions creativity to bring opportunities to people around the world.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $135,159,392 to $154,393,066, a 1.14x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
